summary: Frontend smoke + feature-surface testing on Chez Dina console. 18/19 console tabs load without crashes. Statistiques page CRASHES with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' because /console/statistiques still uses old shape (k.rev_month etc.) while backend /dashboard/kpis now returns {value,prev,delta,description} objects. All other new features (period filter, KPI deltas, drill-down, global search, theme/lang toggles, notifications panel, floating AI chat, POS modes + new customer modal, Customers segments + CRUD, Promotions form, Deliveries 4 tabs + zones, Reviews 3 tabs, Alerts 2 tabs, Site/Settings/Team pages) render and all documented data-testid selectors are present and clickable.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes with 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {value, prev, delta, description})'. Statistics.jsx was NOT rewritten in this iteration — it still renders primitives like fcfa(k.rev_month) and k.orders_count directly, but /api/dashboard/kpis now returns objects {value,prev,delta,description}. Entire page is blank (body length 0). React error boundary logged. Note: review request mentions 'Statistics.jsx - full rewrite with 6 charts' but file in repo is the old 30-line version.
Clicking kpi-orders-detail does not expose role='dialog'. Likely a custom overlay without ARIA role. Low priority — functionally may still work, only automation/a11y impacted.

action_items: URGENT: Rewrite /app/frontend/src/pages/console/Statistics.jsx to consume the new KPI object shape (k.rev_month.value, k.orders_count.value, etc.) and add the 6 charts promised (hour/category/sizes/colors/top10/expenses by cat/status). Current file is the old 30-line version — appears the rewrite was not committed.
Minor: add role='dialog' to Dashboard drill-down modal container for accessibility/testability.
Minor: review mentions 'hero-save' testid; actual element uses 'site-save' — align docs or add alias.
critical_code_review_comments: Statistics.jsx not updated to match new API contract — classic breaking change not propagated. Suggests the file was never saved from the iteration described in review request.
No ErrorBoundary around route content; a single component crash blanks the whole page instead of a scoped fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login works via first 2 input fields + 'Se connecter' button. All documented data-testid selectors verified present on their pages. The ONLY crashing tab is /console/statistiques — the file at /app/frontend/src/pages/console/Statistics.jsx is still the old 30-line version that reads k.rev_month as a primitive; backend now returns {value,prev,delta,description}. Fixing Statistics.jsx to use .value accessors (or rewriting as per review spec) should bring frontend to 100%.
rca of the issue: Backend /api/dashboard/kpis contract changed from returning primitive numbers to {value,prev,delta,description} objects (new Delta model). Dashboard.jsx was rebuilt to consume this shape, but Statistics.jsx was left as the old implementation that renders {fcfa(k.rev_month)} — React chokes trying to render a plain object as a child. Fix: either update Statistics.jsx to read k.rev_month.value / k.orders_count.value / k.avg_basket.value / k.items_sold.value, or ship the promised full rewrite with the 6 charts.
